title: Strandfontein (Korvette Rd, approx.): man, 26, found shot dead, 19 Oct
summary: Police say a man of 26 was found with multiple gunshot wounds in front of a property in Korvette Road, Strandfontein, when officers responded at about 20:45 on Monday 19 October (Lieutenant-Colonel Frederick van Wyk, via...
story: Police say a man of 26 was found with multiple gunshot wounds in front of a property in Korvette Road, Strandfontein, when officers responded at about 20:45 on Monday 19 October (Lieutenant-Colonel Frederick van Wyk, via Cape Argus and TygerBurger). No source says when he was shot. Strandfontein police registered a murder case; police believe the motive is gang-related. No arrest has been reported. The victim was not named. Two reports, both resting on one police account: TygerBurger and Cape Argus (IOL). Both also describe other Strandfontein shootings on 16 and 17 October; those are not part of this pin.
incident: Mon 19 Oct 2026, found when police responded at about 20:45 (police, via Cape Argus and TygerBurger). 20:45 is the response and discovery time, not a shooting time; no source gives one.
location_note: In front of a property in Korvette Road, Strandfontein (police, via Cape Argus). House not given. The pin is a street-level marker for Korvette Road (OpenStreetMap), kept where the builder put it on the owner's decision; it marks the road, not any building or house.

provenance.statement_from: Police: Lt-Col Frederick van Wyk (Cape Argus: 'police spokesperson'; TygerBurger: 'commander of the provincial media centre'), quoted by TygerBurger and Cape Argus
other_voices: Ward councillor Elton Jansen (about policing, not the killing)
provenance.note: One police account, two reports in different media groups (Nova News and Independent Media). Cape Argus quotes Van Wyk directly and in reported speech; TygerBurger paraphrases. Repetition is not independent corroboration. The councillor speaks only about the police response.

facts.label: Deaths
facts.detail: Found with multiple gunshot wounds. Both reports relay one police account. The victim was not named.
